title: Old Fashioned German Dulce De Leche Tart
description: A tangy and chewy German dessert featuring dulce de leche in a flaky crust, served in a tagliere vessel, this macrobiotic friendly tart is perfect for cozy nights.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: chilled and cut into small pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and confectioners sugar.
Add the cold butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the mixture into the bottom and up the sides of a tagliere vessel.
Bake the crust for 20 minutes, or until it is lightly golden.
While the crust is baking, whisk together the dulce de leche, eggs, vanilla extract, and sea salt in a separate bowl.
When the crust is ready, remove it from the oven and pour the dulce de leche mixture into the crust.
Return the tart to the oven and bake for an additional 25 minutes, or until the filling is set.
Remove the tart from the oven and allow it to cool completely before serving.
